needed.evidence: No footway visible on the left side of the road, with people walking on the roadway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk of at least 1-metre width along the left side to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Visible uneven sections that pose trip hazards on the narrow footpath
needed.suggestion: Repave the right side footway to ensure a flat, smooth surface that reduces tripping hazards for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Obstructions such as parked vehicles and stalls that partly block the footway
needed.suggestion: Restrict parking and vendor stalls along the right side footway to maintain clearance for pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: Lack of any marked or purpose-built crossing for pedestrians, despite high crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing with kerb ramps at a central location where people frequently cross.

needed.evidence: Inadequate street lighting along the urban roadway
needed.suggestion: Add more streetlights along the road to enhance visibility and safety during nighttime.
